statement: let psi := fun (q a x : ℕ) => ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n => n%q=a%q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n; ∀ (E : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ), |psi 4 1 x - (x : ℝ)/2| ≤ E x → |psi 4 1 (2*x) - (2*x : ℕ)/ (2 : ℝ)| ≤ E (2*x) → |(psi 4 1 (2*x) - psi 4 1 x) - (x : ℝ)/2| ≤ E (2*x) + E x
